findings.title: Status text coloured by HA's --success/--error/--warning-color fails WCAG AA on the default themes
findings.claim: On HA's default light theme every card text run coloured by a status token is below 4.5:1 (warning 1.96:1, success 3.30:1, error 4.29:1, white on the armed Save button's error fill 4.29:1), and error text is 3.97:1 on the dark theme.
findings.mechanism: The what-if/today's-slots result lines (.cheaper/.dearer, .wi-result.*), the clamped-DHW warning (.wi-hint.wi-warn) and the armed confirm buttons (.wi-save.confirm, .sp-save.confirm) take their colour straight from HA's status tokens, which are not text colours: #43a047, #db4437 and #ffa600 on #fff. The accent colour was given a readable variant (ACCENT_READABLE, text on --primary-text-color); the status tokens were not.

findings.title: Setup layout editor: removing a pipe, drawing a pipe and moving a box have no keyboard route
findings.claim: With the layout editor open, 0 of 12 pipes (3 viewports) can be removed from the keyboard and 0 of 18 boxes moved, while 12 of 12 pipes are removable by mouse click.

findings.title: Now-marker label prints over the measured-now reading on the live default view
findings.claim: On an install that publishes its measured indoor temperature, the chart's 'now' label and the 'now 21.1 °C' reading overlap (13.8x8.6 px glyph boxes at 375 px, ink visibly merged) in the default view, inline and expanded, in 24 of 24 cells.
findings.mechanism: renderChart places text.now-label at (nx+3, plotT+font+1) and text.now-temp at (plotL+6, plotT+font) independently; the default window starts at now so nx ~ plotL. The test rig's planStates omits the measured sensor (withActuals), so no STATES default view draws now-temp. Same property, second seam: the .viewctl reset button over now-label when panned (history_panned, 10 cells of the full grid).

leads.what: The default-view plan states omit the integration's own measured sensors (withActuals), so card_drift/card_browser never render the live default view; D4-s1-05's collision passed every lane for that reason.
The contrast lane measures four fixed sites on fixtures that never produce a status outcome (.cheaper/.dearer/.wi-warn/.confirm), so D4-s1-01 is outside every gate.
Slot and advisor labels reach the card as published strings; whether the backend localizes them for a Swedish UI was not checked (the fixture's are English).
The card prints narrative lines in the language the sensor published, regardless of hass.language; whether the backend follows the UI language was not checked.
